title: Rites at Night's own quest text promises four resolutions ('Pay her fine, argue her oath, break her out -- or leave her to it') but the cell's menu only ever offered two of them (force the gate / pick the lock) plus 'leave her to the Watch' -- 'pay her fine' and 'argue her oath' never appeared as selectable options.
